findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prompt:agentstack_read_bootstrap" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, apikey). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read-only MCP bootstrap with continueOnError; omit apikeys.list without api_keys cap

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "agentstack.execute" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "AUTH-FIRST: auth.get_profile before mutate. IDE: Connect; no auth.login in chat. Unauth: auth_choices; skip work_next. Mutate: OAuth/PAT (mcp:execute). Anon: bootstrap_ack+create_project_anonymous. Spine: plan_get->work_next->plan_claim->plan_execute. WG: work_next->plan_claim->plan_execute; follow " → after: "Batch MCP calls via {steps,context,options}; result.v1 envelope. Contract: GET /mcp/ai_prompt, session_setup, execute_budget prompts. Spine: plan_get->work_next->plan_claim->plan_execute. Follow packet.next_action when set."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
